authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Central route at least 3 m; rack modules use conservative collision envelopes and no reachable unstable stacks. Raised loading dock variants stay non-navigable until an alternate safe route is specified. Target bounding dimensions 20m wide x 6m high x 18m deep. Materials: concrete-weathered. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
